lang.label: Language
app.tagline: Clean speech, on your own machine.
app.sub: Drop in a noisy recording or video. Nothing is uploaded.
drop.title: Drop audio or video files
drop.hint: or click to choose. wav, mp3, m4a, flac, mp4, mov, mkv
engine.classic.hint: 16 kHz denoiser, speech band up to 8 kHz
opt.strength.hint: Lower values blend some of the original back in.
opt.check.hint: Transcribes before and after and lists any word that changed.

drift.title: Word drift check
drift.explain: Whisper listened to both versions. Highlighted words are heard differently after enhancing. The check can also catch the original's own mistakes.

batch.title: {done} of {n} files done
err.lost: Lost contact with Cleartake. Is it still running?
err.gone: This file is no longer on the server. Cleartake keeps only the newest results.
